units: Ḥag. 12ᵃ תהו קו ירוק וכ׳ tohu (Gen. I, 2) is the green (or yellow) circle which surrounds the whole world (the horizon); Yalk. Kings 185 (ref. to I Kings VII, 23) זה קו ירוק וכ׳ this is typical of the green circle &c.
Num. R. s. 13 קו הים שעשה וכ׳ the circle encompassing the basin which Solomon made (I Kings l. c.); a. e.— [cavity,] the lower part of a trumpet.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:7">Kel. XI, 7</cite>, v. <he>קב</he>.—[Tanḥ. Aḥăré 1 <he>קו שררתיה</he>, v. <cite ref="S00674"><he>קוֹשַׁרְתָּא</he></cite>.]
